hero.title: A staffing partner for businesses that need permanent people
hero.intro: We help businesses hire permanent employees for operational, service, skilled trade and office roles — with clear requirements and transparent budgets.

introduction.title: Who we are
paragraphs: StaffHiring is a permanent staffing and recruitment service for businesses. We work with restaurants, hotels, cafes, cloud kitchens, corporate offices, retail stores and commercial establishments that need reliable people in long-term roles.
Sample content: company background, team details and history will be added once the actual business information is provided. No founding date, certifications or achievements are claimed on this page.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To make permanent hiring straightforward for businesses by documenting requirements clearly, sharing budgets honestly and following each requirement through to a confirmed hire.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: A hiring experience where every business, regardless of size, can build a stable team with the same clarity and structure that larger organisations take for granted.

approach.title: How we approach each requirement
approach.intro: The same structured process applies whether a business needs one kitchen helper or a full front-of-house team.

items.title: Understand the business first
items.description: Role titles mean different things in different establishments. We start with how your operation runs day to day.

items.title: Document the requirement
items.description: Role, headcount, shift pattern, budget and timeline are captured in one brief that both sides agree on.

items.title: Be clear about money
items.description: Employee salary and recruitment fees are discussed as separate figures, with estimates marked as estimates.

items.title: Follow through
items.description: One point of contact stays with the requirement from the first conversation to onboarding.

philosophy.title: Our staffing philosophy
paragraphs: Permanent roles deserve a permanent-hiring mindset. A good placement is one where the employee understands the business they are joining and the business understands the person it is bringing on.
We avoid overpromising. Where information is indicative — such as salary ranges — it is labelled as indicative. Where terms depend on the specific requirement, we say so.

industries.title: Industries we serve
industries.intro: Businesses across hospitality, commercial and professional settings.

items.name: Cafes and cloud kitchens
items.description: Compact teams for high-turnover food operations.

items.name: Corporate offices
items.description: Office assistants, utility and support staff.

items.name: Small and medium businesses
items.description: Any permanent role a growing business needs filled.

process.title: Hiring process overview
process.intro: The same four steps apply to every requirement.

cta.headline: Talk to us about your next hire
cta.text: Share your requirement and we will respond with suitable categories and indicative budgets.
